claim: AWS Organizations is offered at no additional charge; you are charged only for the AWS resources that users and roles in your member accounts use.
question: What does AWS Organizations cost?

evidence.quote: AWS Organizations is offered at no additional charge. You are charged only for AWS resources that users and roles in your member accounts use.

claim: The owner of the management account is responsible for paying for all usage, data and resources used by the accounts in the organization.
question: Who pays for usage incurred in the member accounts of an organization?

evidence.quote: The owner of the [management account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html#management-account) is responsible for paying for all usage, data, and resources used by the accounts in the organization.

claim: Sharing resources with other AWS accounts through AWS RAM incurs no additional cost.
question: Does sharing resources with AWS RAM add a charge?

evidence.quote: You can share resources at no additional cost.

claim: Each shared principal referenced in a resource share adds one to the principal quota, but sharing with an entire organization by referencing its ID counts as only one.
question: How does sharing with a whole organization count against the AWS RAM principal quota?

values.display: counts as only one against this quota

evidence.quote: Each shared principal that you reference in a resource share adds one to your quota use. If you share with an entire organization by referencing its ID, it counts as only one against this quota.

claim: Since 2025-11-19 Amazon Inspector can be enabled, configured and managed across an organization with an Inspector policy type in AWS Organizations.
question: When did AWS Organizations add a policy type for Amazon Inspector?

evidence.quote: The new Inspector policy type within AWS Organization simplifies your service onboarding, management, and ensures consistent, organization-wide vulnerability scanning coverage.
Amazon Inspector can now be enabled, configured and managed across your organization using AWS Org policies.

evidence.heading: Amazon Inspector supports organization-wide management through AWS Organizations policies

note: d129. Change feed date 2025-11-19 confirmed. Not in the saved Organizations quota tables (they list no Inspector policy row).

claim: Since 2025-11-21 AWS Organizations supports the upgrade rollout policy, which staggers automatic minor version upgrades across Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS databases so that upgrades start with less critical environments.
question: When did AWS Organizations add the upgrade rollout policy, and what does it do?

qualifiers.scope: per organization, account or resource tag

evidence.quote: Today, AWS Organizations announces support for upgrade rollout policy, a new capability that helps customers stagger automatic upgrades across their Amazon Aurora (MySQL-Compatible Edition and PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition) and Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) including RDS for MySQL, RDS for PostgreSQL, RDS for MariaDB, RDS for SQL Server, RDS for Oracle, and RDS for Db2 databases.

When new minor versions become eligible for automatic upgrade, the policy ensures upgrades start with development environments, allowing you to validate changes before proceeding to more critical environments.

evidence.heading: AWS Organizations now supports upgrade rollout policy for Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS

claim: Since 2025-11-19 Billing Transfer lets customers in multi-organization environments designate a single management account to centrally manage and pay the bills of multiple AWS organizations.
question: What is Billing Transfer for multi-organization billing, and when was it launched?

evidence.quote: With Billing Transfer, customers operating in multi-organization environments can designate a single management account to centrally manage and pay for bills for multiple organizations, including invoice collection, payment processing, and detailed cost analysis.

evidence.heading: AWS launches Billing Transfer for multi-organization billing and cost management
